name: Agile Robots Agile ONE
summary: A 1.74 m, 69 kg industrial humanoid from Munich with two five-finger hands and 20 kg payload, built in series in Germany and sold on request.

germany.statusNote: German maker (Munich). Series production in Fuerstenfeldbruck since late summer 2026; units ship daily. Most shipped units are the wheeled version, because the maker says no certification framework yet exists in Europe for bipedal humanoids working next to people. No public price.

sellers.name: Agile Robots SE
sellers.note: Direct sales from the Munich headquarters; Hitachi will also offer it through HMAX Industry.

specs.label: Payload
specs.conditions: As stated on the product page; not specified per arm or for both arms

specs.label: Joints per hand
specs.conditions: Product page: hands with modular fingers and 21 joints; not stated whether per hand or for both hands

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: Cameras, LiDARs, speech recognition, proximity sensor; force and torque sensor in every joint

notes: Specs are for the legged version shown on the product page.
A wheeled version is built on the same line and makes up most shipments; the maker says it already carries its certification. No separate specs published.
Payload 20 kg is not stated per arm.
No runtime, IP rating or stair capability published.
